My friend is hosting a server with 19 mods, lots of assets. One of my buddies had no problem getting in, but my SPT kept infinite loading artemvest9. Ran this once, and it launched, loaded the remaining assets and let me into the server.

Doesn’t seem like this is a issue specific to ArtemTrader itself, rather having too many assets in general.
